title: Cover Page and Product Overview
training_guidance: This page serves as the cover and introduction to the Bonfiglioli Technical Quality Handbook (MTQ-000, dated 26.10.2010 - 1/1).
The handbook contains engineering standards for power transmission components including gearboxes, planetary drives, and related mechanical assemblies.
Visual reference shows typical Bonfiglioli product families: enclosed gear drives, planetary gearboxes, and shaft-mounted reducers.
Subsequent pages will contain detailed technical standards for component design, tolerancing, and quality control.
summary: Cover page of the Bonfiglioli Technical Quality Handbook (MTQ-000), dated 26.10.2010. The page displays the company branding and a product overview image showing various power transmission assemblies including gearboxes and planetary drives. This handbook provides engineering standards for designing and manufacturing Bonfiglioli mechanical power transmission components.
